title: Sunflower cake → Protein Rich Flour
story: Preferred pilot hypothesis from the supplied research plan. Review ranges are reference evidence; supply lot, route, assays and process costs before a pilot decision.

title: Groundnut cake → Protein Isolate
story: Checks the B1 and total-aflatoxin project thresholds and evidence needed for candidate routes. Batch protein and moisture are synthetic demo values (source plan §8.3 example), not measurements.

title: Soybean cake → Protein Concentrate
story: Explore protein enrichment and the published extrusion evidence for trypsin inhibitors. Soy allergen labelling and a supplier quote are required.

title: Almond cake → Protein Concentrate
story: Explore the evidence gaps for almond cake, including allergen labelling, functional assays and a supplier quote. Missing compound data do not establish that no treatment is needed.

title: Pea protein isolate → Protein Isolate
story: Research reference: 80.2% protein (Qi et al., 2025). Uses the same landed pea price as every comparison. Gellan gum / salt findings guide lab validation; no cake extraction is simulated.
